_doc: One icon per place, the same on the map and in search results.

categories: search category id (packbuilder/search/categories.json, owned by the search track) -> sprite icon name. Every category has one; check_poi_icons.py fails if a category is added there without an icon here.

map_kinds: 'kind' of the 'pois' tile layer (Protomaps basemap schema) -> sprite icon name, for the driving POI layer the style adds (pois_driving). Kinds not listed here keep the stock Protomaps layer, which uses the kind itself as the icon name (stock_kinds).

early_kinds: shown one zoom level before their min_zoom attribute. Measured with count_pois.py: rest areas and service plazas from z12-13 on the highway, parking from z13-14 in town, fuel and EV charging from z15. Shops and cafes of the stock layer are held back to z16 (packbuilder/map/style/style_config.json stock_poi_min_zoom).

truck_stop_names: a 'fuel' or 'services' POI whose name (lower-cased) is one of starts_with, or begins with one of them followed by a space, or contains one of contains, gets the truck_stop icon. The tiles carry no brand or hgv tag, so this name rule stands in for the brand and HGV tags that packbuilder/search/categories.json uses; check_truck_stops.py measures how well the two agree.
Icon art: assets/icons/icons.json. The app can draw an icon from the sprite sheet of the style bundle (sprites/light@2x.png + .json) by name.
stock_kinds: drawn by the stock Protomaps 'pois' layer with icon = kind (beach, forest, marina, park, peak, zoo, garden, bench, aerodrome, station -> train_station, bus_stop, ferry_terminal, stadium, university, library, school, animal, toilets, drinking_water, post_office, building, townhall, restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, supermarket, convenience, books, beauty, electronics, clothes, attraction, museum, theatre, artwork)
